USER LIFECYCLE

01

02

03

04

Hold · stay · release

return, then fade.

06

Save a poem and private note; revisit sources,

pause, export or delete.

LONGITUDINAL HOME STUDY

Proposed · 4–6 opt-in homes · 4 weeks · schedule to be confirmed

Day 0 / Set up

Placement & baseline

→

Weeks 1–2 / Live with

Use, observe & diary

→

Week 3 / Reflect

Interview & ratings

01 / Observe use in everyday life

During agreed home visits, observe placement and the hold–stay–release ritual. Brief diaries and opt-in event logs record use, pauses, interruptions and relocation. Check in weekly.

02 / End-of-study interview

Ask when it felt comforting or intrusive; how it fitted the home and routine; and why people kept, moved, paused or stopped using it.
